title: GIST: Gibbs-Targeted Hierarchical Data Selection for Offline RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2611.06395v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains on a fixed pool of sampled responses and typically supervises every token of every response, although responses and tokens are not equally informative. We study which ones to supervise through the Gibbs-optimal policy of KL-regularized RLVR, which offline training targets, and measure the mismatch between a policy and this target with a bidirectional KL divergence. At the reference policy, this mismatch factorizes exactly and separates the two outcomes: correct responses contribute mainly through the forward term, concentrated on their low-probability tokens, and incorrect responses through the reverse term, concentrated on the responses the policy generates often and on their high-probability tokens. translated_title: GIST：面向离线RLVR的基于吉布斯目标的层级数据选择
translated_abstract: 具有可验证奖励的离线强化学习在固定的采样响应池上进行训练，通常对每个响应的每个token都进行监督，然而响应和token的信息量并不相同。我们通过KL正则化RLVR的Gibbs最优策略（即离线训练的目标）来研究应当监督哪些内容，并用双向KL散度来度量策略与该目标之间的失配。在参考策略处，这种失配可以精确分解，并将两种结果区分开来：正确响应的贡献主要来自前向项，集中于其低概率token上；错误响应的贡献则来自反向项，集中于策略经常生成的响应及其高概率token上。基于这一分析，我们提出了GIST（Gibbs-Targeted Hierarchical Data Selection，吉布斯目标导向的层级数据选择），这是一种两级选择方法，利用可获得的信号来近似上述原则……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出GIST方法，基于双向KL散度在参考策略处的精确分解，揭示出正确响应应聚焦其低概率token、错误响应应聚焦策略高频生成响应的高概率token这两条监督原则，并据此设计两级层级数据选择方法来优化离线RLVR的训练监督。
en_tdlr: GIST is a two-level hierarchical data selection method for offline RLVR that, grounded in the exact factorization of bidirectional KL divergence at the reference policy, supervises low-probability tokens of correct responses and high-probability tokens of frequently generated incorrect responses.
